subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should this stack be narrowed to the plugin-local Matrix QA migration, or do QA/Gateway owners explicitly approve adding Matrix calls to the generic SDK and coupling the global channel-restart admission change here?
rationale: The migration is useful and well-proven, but the current branch crosses public SDK ownership and production-wide Gateway lifecycle boundaries whose permanent scope cannot be safely chosen from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Narrow the PR first
options.body: Remove the Matrix-named generic SDK surface and split the global Gateway restart change into a separately reviewed change with direct lifecycle proof.

options.title: Approve the coupled scope
options.body: Explicitly accept the new SDK contract and all-channel restart semantics, then require focused upgrade, lifecycle, and dependency authorization evidence on the rebased head.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Hold this layer and its dependent workflow PR until the ownership boundaries and conflict state are resolved.

recommendation.title: Narrow the PR first
recommendation.body: Remove the Matrix-named generic SDK surface and split the global Gateway restart change into a separately reviewed change with direct lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the Matrix QA migration stack and the merged prerequisite, so they are the best available coordinator for narrowing the branch or obtaining the required cross-area approvals.
